name: GammaRips
description: Better-quality option contracts every night, and the history to plan the exit, for AI agents. 9 MCP tools over the GammaRips engine: the liquidity-ranked bullish pool (with a free preview), point-in-time feature vectors, fresh liquidity checks, the exit lab (opportunity surfaces, touch probabilities, exit-rule scoring), the raw option price tape, regime context, and methodology playbooks. Your agent builds the trade plan with you: candidates, entry, target, stop, and size. There is no pick endpoint. Educational only. Not investment advice.

auth.instructions: Subscribe at https://gammarips.com/pricing ($29/mo founding price for the first 100 subscribers, $39/mo after that, 30-day free trial). Then pick whichever your client supports. (1) API key: generate it at https://gammarips.com/account (shown once, at creation) and send it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' to https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp. (2) OAuth 2.1: point the client at https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro instead and complete the sign-in it offers. That is the path for chat clients that cannot send a custom header. Without any credential, an anonymous funnel tier is available on https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp: pool preview, daily reports, methodology playbooks, and reference tools.

universe: about 3,500 optionable US stocks, ranked nightly by liquidity; the pool is the bullish slice of the top 100
